_comment: Hand check of the time-evidence proposals (tools/historian/ingest/time-evidence.mjs): 36 attached claims drawn with a seeded generator (6 of tiers A and B, 30 of tier F), each read in its sentence against the event it is attached to and labelled by one reader, the builder: is the claim a statement of about the time of THE EVENT (same day, same phase of the fighting)? Earlier versions of the matcher were measured the same way before they were replaced: unit-family + place + words, 6 of 40 about the event; unit-family + action, 6 of 35. The labels are judgements, and the model minute of the event is the site's own proposal, not a fact.
matcher: time-evidence.mjs tiers A, B (the unit itself or a sentence naming it) and F (a part of the unit, the same kind of thing, within 60 minutes of the site's own minute)
